At exact HEAD `7ac12a73c95f27d73a72dbc862d35a72301be99a`, this plan is not construction-ready. No session payload was inspected. The sealed final authority Receipt is present, but the following discoverable Plan blockers must all be repaired with explicit Behavior/Owner/Red/Green/Scope coverage.

1. **Freeze the actual installed caller contract.** Sections 1 and 9 leave parsing and filenames Apply-local and name only an unspecified package `bin`. Select the executable name and exact grammar/config schema: how Recorder options are separated from the untouched child argv; archive repository/root and collision-free docket-relative identity; cwd, environment/inheritance or overrides, stdin and stdio/signal handling; and declarations for Git references, external inputs, and exhibits. Prove invocation through the installed tarball’s `node_modules/.bin` surface, exact argv elements and context, one spawn, pre-spawn rejection of malformed config, explicit cross-repository archive selection, and no loading/alteration of Pi role/model/help surfaces. Say “included in `npm pack`/git-local distribution,” not npm publication; ADR 0009 still forbids publication.

2. **Close Receipt, audit, redaction, and trust law.** The plan’s simultaneous promises of byte-exact accepted output and typed redaction placeholders leave a credential-bearing Receipt unresolved. Specify extraction only from the package-owned successfully accepted tool-result details through the real acceptance seam—never prose, filenames, exit zero, or schema guessing—and no Receipt when acceptance is absent/rejected/lookalike. If scanning changes Receipt bytes, identify the stored value as a sanitized derivative; never present it as the exact accepted Receipt. A changed discriminant or unlawful typed shape is Recorder failure, and exact-byte closure use requires caller disposition/rerun. Define what package-observed audit acceptance records without synthesizing a second Receipt. Cover every supported package output envelope or their genuinely shared production seam. Also freeze the bounded trust statement: accepted output/audit records package acceptance only; recording, Git, and digests do not prove truth, freshness, authenticity, mergeability, or closure, and a hostile host can fabricate archive bytes.

Every promotable byte and metadata value—including generated manifest values, argv/context, repository identities/URLs, paths, Receipt, copied inputs, and diagnostics—must cross the one scanner. Add red/green cases for secret-bearing metadata/path values and unsupported opaque content, which must be wholly redacted or fail closed. Reports may contain only non-secret rule/structural-location/count data, never secret-bearing paths, context, hashes, or reversible encodings. Document bounded pattern scanning rather than semantic DLP and caller ownership of minimization and rotation.

3. **Freeze the public failure/output law and complete transaction counterexamples.** “Distinct fields” and “observable” outcomes do not define the caller-visible channel. State exactly where the child outcome and Recorder outcome/diagnostic appear on success and Recorder failure, the reserved outward Recorder-failure status, and how child stdout/stderr and exit/signal semantics are preserved when archival promotion succeeds. The matrix must explicitly prove: child success + Recorder failure; child nonzero/signal + successful promoted core and child outward semantics; both failures with Recorder precedence and retained non-secret child diagnostics; absent Receipt without failure; and config failure before spawn. Add the frozen path/lifecycle cases currently missing: traversal, symlink escape, existing identity/no overwrite, scratch outside tracked destinations or mechanically verified ignored, normal-failure cleanup, no final/partial manifest on any Recorder failure, and documented OS-crash residue as host risk. Do not rely on test-only production hooks.

4. **Complete the manifest/admission public behavior.** The plan must name the observable required facts frozen by authority: invocation identity; sanitized exact argv/context identity; package/model/target identity as caller-supplied provenance where applicable; every admitted artifact and redaction status; separate child and successful Recorder completion; and reference-vs-once-stored identity. Clarify that the caller declares the authority/task/input/exhibit set, Recorder mechanically verifies it, and neither declaration nor Git coordinates prove authority/truth/future availability. Red/green must cover dirty/untracked/cross-repository material, exact-reference mismatch, mandatory omission, duplicate copies, generated artifacts falsely presented as pending/future Git references, and unchanged index/HEAD with caller-owned commit/push/permissions/retention/closure.

5. **Reorder construction onto the small branch first.** The current issue-10 tree is mechanically `417,253,089` logical bytes and HEAD is 39 commits above default `6e76efa93588844996611b86320de7747cca3d24`. The proposed order performs implementation, failure work, fixture audit, and migration on that ancestry and reconstructs only at step 7. That unnecessarily keeps all work on the 398 MiB history. First take a metadata-only retained-path/blob/SHA-256 inventory and record the current default full SHA; then immediately create the object-removing/default-based branch and perform migration dispositions, tests, implementation, docs, and all later commits there. Treat the oversized branch as read-only source until seal equality is proved; do not cherry-pick ancestry-bearing commits or forward-delete blobs. Preserve this plan and later judgment as exact small artifacts when replaying. The final red/green gate must prove default ancestry, exact retained-byte equality, explicit dispositions, exact total and issue-10 subtree logical sizes, mergeability, and no reachable generic session/tool-event exhaust.

6. **Remove unsupported extra mechanisms.** Do not institute a repository-wide audit/graduation of existing `test/fixtures/judge-postures` or a generic duplicate-probe inventory merely because Recorder is added; touch an affected seam only if this construction creates an irreducible fixture, then graduate/delete exactly once there. Likewise authority requires reproducible final ancestry/size evidence, not a permanent CI numeric-retention engine. Prefer a one-time mechanical report/reused Git commands unless an existing seam demonstrates a regression gate is needed. Keep legacy migration to the approved recoverable small claim-chain inventory and forward dispositions, with no new `/tmp` archaeology or generic raw retention.

note: Once these public choices and counterexample oracles are fixed, scanner algorithms, serialization internals, temporary names, and ordinary test-fixture mechanics remain Apply obligations and should not trigger another plan rewrite.
